description: As compliant, but a reduce-only order create, the flatten's position-closing order, is rejected with retCode 110017, the reduce-only family of the official v5 error table (#3005). The stub matches reduceOnly true in the request body (#2893 S11), so any other create, such as the plan's section 9.7 reference order, passes it over and compliant's ack answers. TC-305's open position comes from the overlay open_position_btcusdt_5x_sl, so no opening order is needed.

POST /v5/order/create.note: No recorded close rejection exists. 110017 and its message come from the official v5 error table (page dated 2026-10-14, #2893 S15; #3005): the reduce-only family, which mapping.py maps to reduce_only_violation. The message is the table's description, not a recorded reply.

expected.outcome: The flatten failure is shown with the exchange's reason; the key is not reported revoked unless it was; the remaining choices are offered.
